basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old enthusiast from Austin, Texas. As a web developer, I spend most of my days coding and solving tech puzzles. When I'm not working, I'm either playing Pokemon Go or polishing my collection of cowboy boots. I've been fascinated with custom cars, especially the Scion tC, and often find myself discussing mods and upgrades online. I'm currently single and usually online during late evenings when my work and hobbies quiet down.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and a passion for learning new technologies, which I often apply in my web development projects. My interest in cowboy boots and cars stems from a family tradition and a hands-on approach to fixing and styling them.
